avo--classic.description: AVO Classic is the original AVO blend, created by master blender Hendrik Kelner with jazz musician Avo Uvezian, whose brand dates to 1987. A sun-grown Ecuador Connecticut wrapper covers a Dominican binder and aged Dominican filler. Mild to medium, it is creamy and smooth with cedar and nuts, gaining cocoa and light spice later.

thirds.notes: Aromatic and nearly herbal, with a root-like note, cacao and nutmeg in a creamy smoke.
Turns rounder, with honey and cinnamon and a soft sandalwood-like note; the body grows a little.
Deeper and more sombre: cedar and oak, with pepper on the retrohale.

avo--classic-maduro.description: AVO Classic Maduro wraps a milder blend of Dominican long filler in an oily, twice-fermented Connecticut Broadleaf maduro leaf. The broadleaf adds natural sweetness to a rich, earthy profile with chocolate, oak, espresso and hints of pepper, at a medium strength that suits the hour after dinner.

sources.title: Bespoke Unit – AVO Classic Maduro review

thirds.notes: Creamy malt with clove on the retrohale and a cherry-like fruit note.
The fruit fades for cocoa bean, a resinous wood note and a tonka-like creaminess.
Leather and robust coffee bean, with nutmeg on the retrohale.

avo--expresivo.description: AVO Expresivo pairs an Ecuadorian wrapper with a Honduran binder and a filler of Honduran and Nicaraguan Jalapa tobacco, a step away from AVO's Dominican core. Medium to full, it shows cedar, toasted almond and warm cream, with a touch of dark chocolate and a refined pepper on the retrohale.

avo--heritage.description: AVO Heritage was blended by Avo Uvezian and Hendrik Kelner and is made at the Davidoff factory in the Dominican Republic. A dark Ecuadorian sun-grown wrapper covers Cuban-seed Dominican binder and filler; the smoke is medium to full, with cocoa, toasted nuts, cedar, leather and black pepper over a faint apple-like sweetness.

thirds.notes: Savoury molasses sweetness with liquorice root and charred oak.
Unsweetened cocoa, Brazil nut and nutmeg take over.
Earth, a resinous wood and coffee bean; the strength holds steady rather than climbing.

avo--syncro-nicaragua.description: Syncro Nicaragua, launched in 2016, was the first AVO blend to use Nicaraguan tobacco: an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over a Dominican binder and a Dominican and Nicaraguan filler that includes leaf from Ometepe. It builds slowly from mild to medium, with creamy cedar, baker's spice, leather and dark cocoa, and raisin sweetness through the middle.

thirds.notes: Baker's spice, creamy cedar, leather and dark cocoa, with raisin and white pepper on the retrohale.
Raisin sweetness grows while creamy cedar leads, joined by coffee beans, earth and dark chocolate.
Creamy cedar stays in front with almond, buttery bread and coffee, and a light floral note at the end.

sources.title: Davidoff Geneva – AVO Syncro 10th Anniversary (Syncro Nicaragua background)
halfwheel – AVO Syncro Nicaragua Special Toro review

avo--syncro-10th-anniversary-limited-edi.description: Released in April 2025 to mark ten years of Syncro Nicaragua, this limited edition is a box-pressed Diademas Finas of 6⅝ by 50, packed in commemorative boxes of 20. An Ecuadorian wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and a Nicaraguan and Dominican filler, a Nicaraguan-forward blend that is full in body and medium-full in strength.

thirds.notes: Creamy and smooth, with warm spice from the binder, brown-sugar sweetness, coffee, chocolate and cedar.
Roasted notes and dried fruit appear, and leather comes in as the profile deepens.
Dark chocolate, fresh spice and earthy tones close the cigar, intense but balanced.

sources.title: Davidoff Geneva – AVO Syncro 10th Anniversary Limited Edition
Moodie Davitt Report – Oettinger Davidoff marks ten years of Syncro Nicaragua
The Cigar Authority – AVO Syncro 10th Anniversary

avo--syncro-fogata.description: Syncro Nicaragua Fogata layers an Ecuadorian Habano 2000 Clara wrapper over a Mexican San Andrés Negro binder and long filler from the Dominican Republic and from Estelí and Condega in Nicaragua. It leans on spice, pepper and earth, a spicier, more earthy take on the Syncro idea than the original Syncro Nicaragua.

sources.title: Cigar Page – AVO Syncro Nicaragua Fogata
Mike's Cigars – AVO Syncro Fogata review

thirds.notes: Creamy with a quiet sweetness, mild wood and spice, and a faint earthy touch.
Still creamy and sweet, with more wood and a subtler earth.
Cream and sweetness hold, with wood and a light leather as the strength rises.

avo--syncro-ritmo.description: Syncro Ritmo is a box-pressed AVO blend that draws on five countries: an Ecuadorian wrapper and a Mexican binder over long filler from Nicaragua, Peru, Brazil, Honduras and the Dominican Republic. The profile is nutty, earthy and spicy, layered and medium to full in strength.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – AVO Syncro South America Ritmo Toro
Bespoke Unit – AVO Syncro Ritmo review

thirds.notes: Pepper and sweet spice over oak, dark coffee and baker's chocolate, with hazelnut and a grapefruit note.
Roasted nuts and leather join a cappuccino-like coffee and toasted oak.
Black pepper grows on the retrohale over charred oak, leather and toasted rye.

avo--syncro-caribe.description: Syncro Caribe turns AVO's Syncro idea toward the Caribbean: a Dominican wrapper over an Ecuadorian binder and a long filler of Dominican and Nicaraguan tobacco. It brings cocoa and baking spice in a measured smoke, one of the four blends in the Syncro family.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – AVO Syncro Caribe Toro

thirds.notes: Strong earth with raisin and sweet coffee, dry leather and white pepper, and cedar on the finish.
Salted chocolate and cream, with roasted nuts and leather; the earth recedes.
Cedar sweetness and rising pepper heat, with strong leather and a molasses note.

avo--xo.description: AVO XO, with vitola names taken from music, from Preludio to Maestoso, rolls Dominican long filler and binder aged six years in a silky Ecuadorian Connecticut shade wrapper. Smooth and balanced at a medium strength, it opens with cedar, dried fruit and light spice and turns toward cream, roasted nuts and a little pepper.

sources.title: Smoke Signals Weekly – AVO XO review

thirds.notes: Silky and balanced: grilled almond and cream with light spice and a dry, herbal edge.
Cacao nib and biscuit-like sweet spice, with cedar, cream and a hint of citrus.
Espresso and cashew, with wood, a little leather and a mineral finish.
